applicability: Detecting motion-driven urgency while static COM margin remains positive
Reporting mirrored loss direction and a bounded reaction-time estimate
claim: In the exact certified BR8.1 arithmetic fixtures, the declared oracle computes linear-capture position and boundary time, mirrors velocity and loss direction, distinguishes static from capture urgency, reports a reaction-viable warning when warranted, labels the delayed negative control REACTION_TOO_LATE, and rejects nonfinite velocity.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact BR8.0 static-margin, support-count, and impact-deadline oracles; BR8.1 linear-capture margin, boundary-clock, mirrored-direction, and delayed REACTION_TOO_LATE oracles; BR8.2 immediate STAND/PRECARIOUS/BRACE escalation and hysteretic one-state-at-a-time release; and BR8.3 passive central-horizontal-impulse, slowly-tilting-platform, and disappearing-right-support program scopes named by the source-pinned programs. BR8.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. Every live fixture retains an explicit unpowered Generic6DOF planar guide: sagittal X/Y translation and pitch are released while out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw remain locked, and all guide motors and springs remain off. Detector and supervisor outputs are observations, not force, torque, brace, step, foot-pin, root-rescue, creature-edit, or guidance commands. The declared timing thresholds, rigid-body geometry, masses, friction, timestep, solver, central impulse, platform rotation, support removal, measured transforms, measured velocities, and observed contact membership retain their exact fixture scopes. This establishes early loss-of-viability detection in the passive planar-scaffold matrix only, not an executed existing-contact brace, catch step, new support contact, free 3D standing, unconstrained balance, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared linear-capture oracle computes exact capture position and boundary time, mirrors velocity and loss direction, distinguishes static from capture urgency, fires while reaction remains viable when warranted, labels the delayed negative control REACTION_TOO_LATE, and rejects nonfinite velocity.

failure_boundaries: The linear-capture approximation is not a nonlinear viability kernel or a physical recovery controller
Reaction-viable means only that the declared timing inequality remains open; it does not prove a feasible brace
No executed brace, catch step, free 3D standing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: The oracle projects horizontal velocity through the declared linear inverted-pendulum timescale and compares the resulting capture position with the support boundary. A boundary clock estimates when present motion crosses that boundary.
scope: Only the declared linear-capture approximation, one-dimensional support interval, COM height and velocity inputs, gravity, thresholds, source, and program claim scope certified by br8_20260723T144351Z_90b2c1ce.
title: The certified linear-capture oracle separates static margin from motion-driven urgency
